title: Sony PlayStation 2 Memory Card PS2 Genuine Official MagicGate 8MB SCPH-10020
categoryName: Video Games & Consoles:Video Game Accessories:Memory Cards & Expansion Packs
descriptionText:
This Sony PlayStation 2 Memory Card is the perfect addition to your gaming setup. With a storage capacity of 8 MB, it provides ample space to store your favorite games and other media. The card is genuine and official, ensuring that you get the best performance and longevity.

Compatible with Sony PlayStation 2, this memory card is a must-have for any serious gamer. It is designed for ease of use and comes with all the necessary connectivity options, including PS/2 and wired. The card is lightweight, weighing only 0.6 oz, and has a compact size of 2.20 x 1.65 x 0.3 in. Manufactured in Japan, it features OEM technology and is compatible with Memory Cards.
